name: RotatingWords
description: Static prefix followed by a slot that springs through a list of accent-colored words on an interval, reserving the widest word's width so nothing around it shifts.
a11yNotes: A visually hidden span reads the prefix and full word list once; the animated slot is aria-hidden. The slot width is reserved by invisible sizer copies, preventing layout shift. Under prefers-reduced-motion the interval is not started and the first word is shown statically.
